items.headline: Singleton throws for 3 TDs in 1st half as App State opens season by beating FCS-program Maine 55-3
items.description: — Malachi Singleton threw for 291 yards and three touchdowns on 22-of-24 passing to help Appalachian State open its season by beating FCS-program Maine 55-3 on Saturday.
